format: Each front end of the engine (architecture/engine.md, Parity), and the manifest it published at a pinned commit, as a file in checks/. A front end with no manifest makes checks/front-end-parity.py --parity NOT RUN, never ok. The CLI's manifest is `weblisk commands --json`, which is not built yet; Studio's is its operations route, which is not built yet. Today's CLI commands are measured instead in cli-verbs.json, against architecture/cli.md's Command Surface.
